sentences.en: The king heard about Juha in the city.
He called him to come to the palace.
The king asked: are you a wise man?
The king laughed and said: really?

sentences.ar: הוא אמר: אז תלמד את החמור.
sentences.en: He said: then teach the donkey.
He said: teach it to read.
Juha said: there is no problem at all.

sentences.ar: הוא אמר: אני צריך עשר שנים.
sentences.en: He said: I need ten years.

sentences.ar: הוא אמר: ואני צריך גם כסף.
sentences.en: He said: and I also need money.

sentences.ar: המלך נתן לו שק של זהב.
sentences.en: The king gave him a sack of gold.
A friend asked him on the way home.
He said: you are completely mad.

sentences.ar: הוא אמר: החמור לא יקרא לעולם.
sentences.en: He said: the donkey will never read.

sentences.ar: ג'וחא אמר: עשר שנים זה הרבה.
sentences.en: Juha said: ten years is a lot.
He said: either the king will die.
He said: or I shall die.
He said: or the donkey will die.
